fixed_management.notes: Total expense ratio of the share class as the factsheet prints it (marketing material for UK investors; performance and net assets at 30-Sep-2026, all other data at 05-Oct-2026). The prospectus and key information document were not opened. Listed on TASE: the factsheet's p. 3 says 'also listed on: Tel Aviv Stock Exchange'; the number and the NIS line come from BlackRock's Israel brochure (library 5fae6c1d0933c1bc, p. 1, 2026-10-01), which prints the same fee.

source.title: iShares NASDAQ 100 UCITS ETF U.S. Dollar (Accumulating), CNDX, factsheet 'October 2026', iShares VII plc, p. 2 'Calendar year performance'

tracking_difference_12m.notes: Not printed as one number. The factsheet 'October 2026' (marketing material; performance as at 31-Oct-2026) prints the fund's return and its benchmark's for each calendar year 2016 to 2025 on p. 2; they are in tracking_record. Fund basis: 'Performance is shown on a Net Asset Value (NAV) basis, with gross income reinvested where applicable', in US dollars. Benchmark as the document names it: 'NASDAQ 100 Index'; the iShares VII plc prospectus (p. 44) makes the objective its net total return, so the benchmark is recorded as net (tracking_record.benchmark). The difference is not computed here (data-update rule).
